title: Juicy Saudia Onion Stir-fry
description: A tangy and juicy Saudi Arabian dish featuring gluten-free onion in a bhuna spice blend for midnight cravings.
instructions: Chop the onion into thin strips.
In a pan, heat some oil and add sliced ginger. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped onions to the pan and sauté over medium heat for about 5-7 minutes or until they turn translucent but not browned.
Pour in the tomato sauce and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the bhuna spice blend evenly on top of the onion mixture. Stir well to coat all ingredients.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Continue cooking for about 3 more minutes until everything is heated through.
Remove from heat and let it sit for a minute before serving.
